content.short: Pytest Cobra is a Python-based testing tool for EVM-compatible smart contracts.
content.description: Sponsored by willing donors, Pytest Cobra lets developers write small tests for targeted sections of code on the fly and scale as codebases grow. With just a few lines of code, you can execute and validate those sections, enabling fast feedback and more confidence during development. The approach keeps test setup lightweight while supporting bigger projects as features evolve. A growing open‑source community of more than 700 developers keeps the repository active and feature‑rich, driving ongoing improvements to testing workflows and tooling.
